title: Wagon cup holder: v4, shaped bracket instead of a block
subtitle: Clip stays on the side rail · cup module lifts off its dovetail · the bracket now flares and sweeps into the cup holder · shown assembled, in print orientation · millimetres
scale_note: Real size, shown assembled. The rail is your 22.3 mm tube. The tumbler is from retailer listings (70 mm base, 89 mm widest). The two wireframe blocks are the red latch and diagonal strut at each end of your 120 mm clear stretch. They are APPROXIMATE: only the ~26 mm reach is from you, and I assumed they sit only beyond the clear stretch. It is drawn in print orientation: the rail axis is vertical here and the cup lies on its side. In use the rail is horizontal and the cup stands upright, hanging off the outside of it.
notes_title: What changed, and what to check
notes: v4: you didn't like the big block between the clip and the cup holder. It's gone. In its place is a shaped bracket: a slim pad around the dovetail whose walls stay about 4 mm thick around the groove and flare out at 45 degrees, then sweep into the web with a 16 mm radius underneath and an 8 mm blend on top. It no longer spans the full width of the cup holder, and it still prints with no supports. Nothing about the fit changed: same dovetail, same clip, cup still 84 mm out and 60 mm down, still clear of the latch and strut zones. Turn the clip off in the viewer to see the bracket on its own. Please tell me: (1) is this the look you wanted, or should it be slimmer still, or hollowed out with windows? (2) the earlier checks still stand: does the diagonal strut slope in under the cup, and does the empty clip block folding?
